referenceDelta.scope: Full wire/wire and wire/via planar widths against all exported islands physically labeled GND minus span-qualified Excellon and NPTH holes. Only real own component terminal .36mm aperture masks; direct surface SMT footprint masked on its own routing surface only. No midpoint or foreign-hole masks. Spatial comparison allows2um exported-coordinate tolerance for previously uncovered polygons, not a clearance waiver. No SI/fabrication qualification.

surfaceNeckModel.method: Erode actual GND Gerber copper by half the board minimum trace width before subtracting actual drills. A same-surface path must survive this erosion; no dilation rejoins separated pieces. Erosion before drilling preserves annular contact at these pads. Conservative geometric screen, no SI/PI qualification.

padViaCoverage.scope: CPU rectangle x[-10,10], y[-12,12] mm. Native named pad vias only. Same actual post-drill surface copper island as an exported through GND barrel; via land contained in its SMT pad; no trace/pour selector references. DC candidates only, no SI/PI or fabrication qualification.
